title: Chapter 18: Subjunctive: Desires
description: Express what you want others to do using 'Je veux que'.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu parles.
sentences.english: I want you to speak.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu manges.
sentences.english: I want you to eat.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu vives ici.
sentences.english: I want you to live here.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu étudies aujourd'hui.
sentences.english: I want you to study today.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu travailles demain.
sentences.english: I want you to work tomorrow.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu ouvres la porte.
sentences.english: I want you to open the door.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu fermes la fenêtre.
sentences.english: I want you to close the window.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu attendes ici.
sentences.english: I want you to wait here.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu m'écoutes.
sentences.english: I want you to listen to me.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu me regardes.
sentences.english: I want you to look at me.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu me dises la vérité.
sentences.english: I want you to tell me the truth.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu me le dises.
sentences.english: I want you to tell it to me.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu le lui donnes à Ana.
sentences.english: I want you to give it to Ana.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu la lui donnes à Luis.
sentences.english: I want you to give it to Luis.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu viennes maintenant.
sentences.english: I want you to come now.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu ailles avec moi.
sentences.english: I want you to go with me.

sentences.french: Veux-tu que je parle ?
sentences.english: Do you want me to speak?

sentences.french: Oui, je veux que tu parles.
sentences.english: Yes, I want you to speak.

sentences.french: Non, je ne veux pas que tu parles.
sentences.english: No, I don't want you to speak.

sentences.french: Veux-tu que j'ouvre la porte ?
sentences.english: Do you want me to open the door?

sentences.french: Oui, je veux que tu ouvres la porte.
sentences.english: Yes, I want you to open the door.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu arrives tôt.
sentences.english: I want you to arrive early.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu n'arrives pas en retard.
sentences.english: I want you not to arrive late.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu t'asseyes ici.
sentences.english: I want you to sit here.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu restes à la maison.
sentences.english: I want you to stay at home.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu achètes du pain.
sentences.english: I want you to buy bread.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu achètes du café.
sentences.english: I want you to buy coffee.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu l'achètes aujourd'hui.
sentences.english: I want you to buy it today.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu l'achètes demain.
sentences.english: I want you to buy it tomorrow.

sentences.french: Je veux que tu les achètes aujourd'hui.
sentences.english: I want you to buy them today.

grammarExplanation:
Just like Spanish, French uses the subjunctive mood after expressions of desire when there are two different subjects connected by 'que' (e.g., 'I want that you do something').

Pattern: 'Je veux que + [Subject 2] + [Subjunctive Verb]'

French Subjunctive 'Tu' form endings:
• For most verbs (like -ER), it looks identical to the present tense (e.g., que tu parles, que tu manges).
• Irregular subjunctives are very important: dire → dises, venir → viennes, aller → ailles.

je veux.mnemonic: I vouch for what I want.

parles.explanation: Subjunctive of parler (tu form). Matches present.

manges.explanation: Subjunctive of manger (tu form). Matches present.

vives.explanation: Subjunctive of vivre (tu form). Matches present.

étudies.explanation: Subjunctive of étudier (tu form). Matches present.

travailles.explanation: Subjunctive of travailler (tu form). Matches present.

ouvres.explanation: Subjunctive of ouvrir (tu form). Matches present.

attendes.explanation: Subjunctive of attendre (tu form). Attends -> Attendes.

écoutes.explanation: Subjunctive of écouter (tu form). Matches present.

regardes.explanation: Subjunctive of regarder (tu form). Matches present.

dises.explanation: Subjunctive of dire (tu form). (Irregular: dise, dises, dise).

donnes.explanation: Subjunctive of donner (tu form). Matches present.

viennes.explanation: Subjunctive of venir (tu form). (Irregular: vienne, viennes).

ailles.explanation: Subjunctive of aller (tu form). (Irregular: aille, ailles).

arrives.explanation: Subjunctive of arriver (tu form). Matches present.

restes.explanation: Subjunctive of rester (tu form). Matches present.

achètes.explanation: Subjunctive of acheter (tu form). Matches present.

demain.mnemonic: Domain — tomorrow is a new domain.

tôt.mnemonic: Rhymes with 'go' — early, time to go!
